Method of Attack: Data breach via hacking systems of a Meta contractor
Leaking personally identifiable information (PII) including names, phone numbers, email addresses, Facebook IDs, and profile information
Enabling phishing attacks, mobile phishing attacks, and SIM swap attacks to hijack accounts
Indicators of Compromise: Leaked database containing 200,000 Facebook Marketplace user records
Email addresses and phone numbers leaked online
Previous breaches linked to IntelBroker: DC Health Link, Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE), General Electric Aviation, Weee! grocery service
